hv-capital._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company rendered under different names across HV's surfaces (the 2026 export, the 2022-25 Storyblok lists, the 2006-2017 holtzbrinck-ventures.com pages) and its renames. Canonical = the row that already carries the grind's answers, so a merge never moves a verdict (s8, rekey). Written during the grind (PRO-104, 2026-09-29) and applied at the one scheduled rebuild.

merges.name: bücher.de
merges.reason: one company: the online bookshop buecher.de (Augsburg), rendered 'Buecher.de' on the unit's 2006-11 exits pages and 'bücher.de' on the 2022-25 lists

merges.name: Fashion For Home
merges.reason: one company: fashion4home (the old site's key and name) is Fashion For Home, the Berlin furniture shop Home24 bought in 2015

merges.name: Flix
merges.reason: one company: FlixBus (2013), 'FlixBus MeinFernbus' after the 2015 merger with MeinFernbus, renamed Flix SE; the live export's name

merges.name: kyte
merges.reason: one company: the old site's 'decentral.tv / kyte' entry is Kyte (kyte.com), the 2006 mobile video platform

merges.name: Spark Networks
merges.reason: one company: eDarling's operator Affinitas GmbH bought Spark Networks Inc. in 2017 and took the name Spark Networks SE; Holtzbrinck Ventures NM's 13Gs 2017-2020 are this position

merges.name: atolls
merges.reason: one company: Global Savings Group renamed itself atolls in 2023

merges.name: Classmarkets
merges.reason: one company: Classmarkets GmbH operated the property portal immobilo (the firm's 2015 navigation: 'classmarkets/immobilo')

merges.name: Flank
merges.reason: one company: Legal OS (Berlin, 2018) renamed itself Flank; the same legalos.io site and the same HV position (2019)

merges.name: mopay

merges.name: rabot.energy
merges.reason: one company: Rabot Charge renamed rabot.energy (Hamburg, founded 2021)

merges.name: Solaris

merges.name: Billpay
merges.reason: one company: 'Wonga/Billpay' is the firm's own 2015 label for Billpay under its owner Wonga

merges.name: CupoNation
merges.reason: one company: HV's DropGifts investment of 2012 pivoted into CupoNation in 2013 ('CupoNation statt DropGifts', deutsche-startups 2013-11-18)

merges.name: home24
